dsl.rule_order: first matching rule wins; use default only when no rule matches
dsl.right_operand: typed literal or {field: other_input_name}, with matching operand types

received_late.description: True if received after the effective solicitation deadline, already adjusted for any applicable emergency extension; false if on time.

acceptance_would_unduly_delay.description: Contracting officer determines that accepting this late item would unduly delay the acquisition.

electronic_method_authorised.description: Submission used an electronic commerce method authorised by the solicitation.

gateway_workdays_before_due_date.description: Number of working days before due date on which the initial government gateway received the submission: 0 is due date, 1 is preceding working day.

gateway_minute_of_day.description: Gateway receipt local minute after midnight; 1020 means 17:00.

acceptable_receipt_evidence.description: Evidence of government installation receipt is acceptable under the source.

designated_installation_received_before_.description: The installation designated for receipt received the submission before the effective deadline.

government_control_before_deadline.description: Submission was under government control before the effective deadline.

only_proposal_received.description: It was the only proposal received.

otherwise_successful_proposal.description: The modification relates to an otherwise successful proposal.

modified_terms_more_favourable.description: The modification makes the proposal terms more favourable to the Government.

process_interrupted.description: An emergency or unanticipated event interrupted normal Government processes.

interruption_prevents_timely_receipt.description: That interruption prevents receipt at the designated office by the specified deadline.

urgent_needs_preclude_amendment.description: Urgent Government requirements preclude amendment of the solicitation closing date.

contract_award_imminent.description: Contract award is imminent at the time of considering the late-receipt notice.

award_notice_would_suffice.description: The notice prescribed in 15.503(b) would suffice; treat this externally determined procedural fact as supplied.

late_submission_considerable.question: Can this late item be considered under the exceptions in FAR 15.208(b), including the special successful-proposal modification rule?
late_submission_considerable.scope: Consideration only, not award or acceptance. For on-time items return unknown because this output concerns late-item exceptions. Facts received_late already incorporate any adjusted deadline.

late_notice_required.question: Does FAR 15.208(f) require the contracting officer to send the prompt late-receipt notice for this item?
late_notice_required.scope: Only the notice duty in (f), including its imminent-award/sufficient-notice exception; no claim about other notices.

emergency_deadline_extension.question: Do the supplied circumstances trigger the deemed deadline extension in FAR 15.208(d)?
emergency_deadline_extension.scope: Whether the extension rule triggers. The workflow must preserve that the new deadline is the same specified time of day on the first workday normal processes resume, without inventing a date.

tasks.business_scope: Federal negotiated procurement, archived FAR Part 15 only.

aggregate_amount_usd.description: Aggregate amount of the transaction, in dollars.

effective_micro_threshold_usd.description: Lawfully established and applicable micro-purchase threshold for this recipient/date, supplied as an authoritative case input; do not infer it from current law.

effective_simplified_threshold_usd.description: Lawfully applicable simplified acquisition threshold, supplied for this recipient/date; do not substitute a later statutory value.

state_local_law_permits_micro.description: State and local law permit use of the micro-purchase procedure for this transaction.

price_considered_reasonable.description: Recipient considers the price reasonable on the grounds allowed by the source.

price_reasonableness_documented.description: Recipient maintains documents supporting its price-reasonableness conclusion.

proposed_micro_threshold_usd.description: Micro-purchase threshold the recipient proposes to establish, separate from its already effective threshold.

procurement_divided_or_reduced.description: Recipient divides or reduces the procurement size.

purpose_avoid_larger_requirements.description: Purpose of that division/reduction is merely entering the micro-purchase limit or avoiding requirements applicable to larger acquisitions.

micro_without_quotes_allowed.question: Do the supplied facts satisfy the VI.3.a route to a micro-purchase without competitive quotations?
micro_without_quotes_allowed.scope: This specific route only; effective thresholds are valid supplied inputs. A false answer does not forbid procurement through another route.

cognizant_approval_required.question: Does the proposed micro-purchase threshold require cognizant-agency approval under VI.3.a(2)?
cognizant_approval_required.scope: The over-50000 trigger only. A false result does not establish that self-certification documentation has been completed or that the proposed threshold is effective.

simplified_amount_band_eligible.question: Is the transaction amount in the simplified-acquisition band stated by VI.3.b(1)?
simplified_amount_band_eligible.scope: Amount-band condition only, using supplied effective thresholds; not full procurement authorization.

artificial_split_prohibited.question: Does the stated division/reduction and purpose meet the anti-avoidance prohibition in VI.3.a(3)(b) or VI.3.b(2)(b)?
artificial_split_prohibited.scope: This prohibition only; false does not certify every other reason for splitting as lawful.

tasks.business_scope: FTA recipient procurement methods under Circular 4220.1G.

contract_amount_usd.description: Contract or purchase-order amount in USD.

contract_category.description: Procurement category. construction means prime construction; other may contain uncharacterised work.

fema_program.description: FEMA financial-assistance program category; HMA includes the Hazard Mitigation Assistance programs.

program_legislation_requires_davis_bacon.description: Known applicability under the other federal program legislation; unknown when absent from the supplied facts.

involves_mechanics_or_laborers.description: Procurement involves employment of mechanics or laborers. All true construction cases are expressly construction work with such employment.

termination_clause_required.question: Is the termination-for-cause-and-convenience contract provision required under section 2.1?
termination_clause_required.scope: This guide edition and provision only. Distinguish requirement from suggestion at/below the threshold.

davis_bacon_clause_required.question: Is the Davis-Bacon contract provision federally required under section 4.1 on the supplied program/contract facts?
davis_bacon_clause_required.scope: Apply PA/HMA exclusion and program-legislation applicability. Unknown applicability must remain unknown when it matters. No opinion on state-law duties.

work_hours_clause_required.question: Is the section 6.1 work-hours/safety provision required for the supplied procurement?
work_hours_clause_required.scope: Classify expressly covered prime construction with mechanics/laborers, and the listed excluded categories. For other work that the facts/source cannot classify, preserve unknown rather than resolve external-law applicability.

clean_air_water_clause_required.question: Is the section 8.1 Clean Air/Water contract provision required?
clean_air_water_clause_required.scope: The guide's amount applicability condition only, at its stated edition.
